_source: Adapted from sagautam5/local-states-nepal (MIT License, https://github.com/sagautam5/local-states-nepal), cross-checked against the official structure published by the Ministry of Federal Affairs and General Administration (MoFAGA): 7 Provinces, 77 Districts, 753 Local Levels (6 Metropolitan City, 11 Sub-Metropolitan City, 276 Municipality, 460 Rural Municipality), 6,743 Wards total, ward counts ranging 5-33 per local level.
_note: Vendored, version-controlled snapshot. Nepal local-level restructuring is a rare, deliberate political event (last major one: 2017) - update this file manually and re-run npm run db:seed if it ever happens; do not wire this to a live third-party API.
